facts.fact: Biometric Update reports RDC-Pass, launched in Kinshasa on 13 June 2026, includes biometric SIM card registration and automated identity verification for financial institutions, with rollout in phases starting with technical audits and pilot testing.

Biometric Update reports RDC-Pass includes automated identity verification for financial institutions, under a PPP giving Trident exclusive e-KYC rights, with phased rollout beginning with audits and pilots.
